page.overview:
Who is Rabbit killed by Michael Myers in 1963?

This unnamed rabbit is an animal that appears in Halloween: The First Death of Laurie Strode.

This rabbit was hopping around the woods near Langdon, Illinois, when it was approached by a young boy named Michael Myers. Moments later, the rabbit was brutally slain by the boy.
